caption: Figure 1 | Historical validation across countries and tasks. Full histogram-based gradient boosting (HGB) models use strict aerosol optical depth (AOD) quality screening, log targets and station-cross-fitted smearing. Panels (A,B) show R² with and without meteorology; (C,D) show corresponding root mean square error (RMSE) in µg m⁻³. T1 denotes station grouping, T2 spatial blocking, T2 buffer the 50-km buffer, and T3 2022 forward-year validation. R² colors use a signed logarithmic scale; labels show untransformed scores. RMSE uses a separate linear scale. NA denotes an unavailable metric; hatched I denotes an ineligible estimate. A dagger marks estimates based on fewer eligible folds. MET denotes meteorological predictors.
